title: Normal force calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point Q using Newton's second law and centripetal acceleration.

title: Pre-collision velocity
description: Essential: Correctly determines block a's speed at Q using conservation of mechanical energy.

title: Post-collision velocities
description: Important: Correctly applies conservation of momentum and kinetic energy for the elastic collision.

title: Block a's rebound height
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum height block a reaches after the collision using energy conservation.

title: Block b's motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly analyzes block b's motion on the conveyor belt, identifying deceleration and uniform motion phases.

title: Total time for block b
description: Essential: Correctly sums the time intervals for block b to travel the length of the conveyor belt.

title: Sign error in velocities
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for post-collision velocity of block a (should be negative for rebound).

title: Friction direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of friction on block b relative to the conveyor belt's motion.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows consistent use of SI units (kg, m, s, N) throughout the solution.
